clue.text: Capital decorations crackers provided, perhaps, at get-together

indicators.note: crackers means crazy, so the letters of the two words beside it are mixed up

explanation.surface: Christmas crackers might supply headgear at a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' means head, so these are decorations worn on the head; the surface also pictures the paper crowns found inside British Christmas crackers, though here 'crackers' signals mixing.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper crowns are worn on the head, the capital being the top part, at festive meals.

clue.text: Swivel camera towards Christmas show on stage

parts.note: to pan is to swing a camera round horizontally
to means towards

explanation.surface: A film crew turns its lens on a seasonal stage production.
explanation.walkthrough: A PANTO (pantomime) is a British family stage show put on around Christmas, full of slapstick and audience participation.
explanation.definitionFit: Pantomime is the traditional British seasonal theatre entertainment, shortened in everyday speech.

clue.text: Christmas gift offer

definitions.meaning: to offer or hand over formally, as a verb

explanation.definitionFit: A gift is a present; to present something is to offer it.

clue.text: The flower of German wine

definitions.meaning: a flower here is something that flows, a river, and this one runs through Germany
... wine, a German white such as hock

explanation.definitionFit: The great German river shares its name with the wines produced along its banks.

clue.text: Boy involved in a row with 1 down part

indicators.note: involved in places the boy inside the other pieces

parts.note: a din is a noisy row
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A youngster gets caught up in a quarrel over a role in a show.
explanation.walkthrough: '1 down' points to PANTO; Aladdin is a classic pantomime title role.
explanation.definitionFit: The lead role in a well-known pantomime story is the boy with the magic lamp.

clue.text: Packets once holding right sort of decorations

indicators.note: holding means the ships contain the next piece

parts.note: packets were steam-driven mail ships, steamers in old usage

explanation.surface: Old mail boats carrying the right kind of festive trimmings.
explanation.walkthrough: A packet (packet boat) was a ship carrying mail; 'Packets' looks like small parcels.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper ribbons hung or thrown at parties are a kind of decoration.

clue.text: She may cook the Christmas dinner, if we go out

definitions.text: She may cook the Christmas dinner

indicators.note: go out suggests the letters leave their order and rearrange

explanation.surface: Whoever cooks the festive meal is ready if the couple head out instead.
explanation.definitionFit: A spouse traditionally pictured preparing the festive roast; a definition by example.

clue.text: A fool to moan about a festive occasion

indicators.note: about means the moaning word goes around the next one

parts.note: to wail is to moan
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: Someone foolish grumbles about a party.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening 'A' is only a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: A wassail is a festive drinking session, especially at Christmas.

clue.text: Anticipation of what might be set for tea or dinner at Christmas

indicators.note: might be suggests the letters could be arranged into something else

explanation.surface: A hint of what the table might hold for the seasonal meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might be' rearranges SET FOR TEA; 'or dinner at Christmas' only completes the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A foretaste is an early sample, an anticipation of what is coming.

clue.text: Very good article on cake decoration

parts.note: angelic means very good, like an angel
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A fine item placed on top of a cake.
explanation.walkthrough: Angelica is candied green plant stem used to decorate cakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Candied stalks of this plant are a traditional cake topping.

clue.text: Roster made out for a skiing holiday?

indicators.note: made out means the letters are worked out into a new order

explanation.surface: A rota drawn up for a trip to the slopes.
explanation.definitionFit: A ski resort is where a skiing holiday takes place, a definition by association hence the question mark.

clue.text: The commanding officer must get present to be consistent

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for commanding officer
here means present

explanation.surface: An officer has to attend in order to stay consistent.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohere is to hold together logically, to be consistent.

clue.text: Exceptionally animated, decorated with glittering ornaments

indicators.note: exceptionally suggests an unusual arrangement of the following letters

explanation.surface: Something unusually lively covered in sparkle.
explanation.definitionFit: Diamante describes fabric covered in sparkling artificial gems.

clue.text: Fish goes on ice, perhaps

definitions.meaning: flat fish of the ray family
glides on blades over ice, as a verb

explanation.definitionFit: Skate is a flat fish; to skate is to glide on ice.

clue.text: Packs gifts without a second thought

indicators.note: without means outside, so the talents go around the other pieces

parts.note: knacks are gifts or talents
PS, a postscript, is an afterthought

explanation.surface: Someone wraps presents without thinking twice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gifts' looks like presents but means talents; 'without' is the old sense of outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Knapsacks are bags carried on the back, a kind of pack.

clue.text: Small present upsets 6 across, about to result in bitter squall

parts.note: now means the present time

indicators.note: about means the turned title goes around the next word
upsets in a down clue turns the title upside down

parts.note: the answer to 6 across is a married woman, whose title is Mrs

explanation.surface: A little gift upsets the cook so much that a storm breaks.
explanation.walkthrough: '6 across' stands for a wife, giving MRS; 'upsets' turns it to SRM, and 'about' puts TO inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A snowstorm is a cold, biting squall of snow.

clue.text: Superfluous things on the tree at the end of Christmas

parts.note: a fir tree's leaves are needles

indicators.note: at the end of picks the last letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Needles dropping off the tree once the festive season is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Needless means unnecessary, more than is required.

clue.text: Party novelties providing all-inclusive benefits

indicators.note: inclusive means the benefits include the other word

parts.note: boons are benefits

explanation.surface: Fun party extras come with an all-in deal of perks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all-inclusive' looks like a holiday package; it splits into 'all' and the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflated rubber toys are typical novelties at a party.

clue.text: Up for Christmas, he will have a way with him

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: Noel means Christmas
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way

explanation.surface: A man is ready for the festivities and has a knack with people.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'he', any man's name fitting the pronoun; 'a way with him' suggests charm.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonard is a male first name, so a man fits the pronoun.

clue.text: Relatively ugly characters in 1 down

parts.note: the plain, related villains of the Cinderella pantomime, with 'Relatively' hinting at family

explanation.definitionFit: Cinderella's stepsiblings are the comic ugly pair in the pantomime.

clue.text: Remained sober, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the word is said out loud

parts.note: staid means sober and serious

explanation.surface: Someone kept off the drink, so it is said.
explanation.definitionFit: To have remained is to have stayed put.

clue.text: Bill's a relation

definitions.meaning: a bill is an ... of money owed, with the 's read as is
a relation is a telling of events, a narrative

explanation.definitionFit: An invoice is an account; a narrative report is also an account.

clue.text: Embraces sweetheart and wives

parts.note: the heart of sweet is its middle letter
wives are spouses

explanation.surface: A man embraces his beloved and his wives.
explanation.definitionFit: To espouse is to embrace a cause or idea.

clue.text: The bird may make a timely appearance

definitions.text: The bird may make a timely appearance

parts.words: The bird may make a timely appearance
parts.note: a bird popping out of a clock on the hour, appearing exactly on time

explanation.definitionFit: The bird in a Swiss clock pops out to mark each hour.

clue.text: It's cold with central heating off!

parts.note: off means unwell, ill

explanation.surface: Turn off the heating and the house goes cold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' looks like switched off but means unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a chill is a feeling of coldness, as in the chill of a winter morning.

clue.text: Decorations have point for those that have eaten too much

definitions.text: those that have eaten too much

parts.note: OBEs are British honours, Orders of the British Empire
E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: Honours come with a moral for gluttons.
explanation.walkthrough: The OBE is a British honour; 'Decorations' looks like Christmas trimmings.
explanation.definitionFit: Obese describes people very overweight from overeating.

clue.text: Volume of tax return accepted by firm starting with nothing

indicators.note: starting with means the zero comes first

parts.note: O is zero, nothing

indicators.note: accepted by means the turned tax is held inside the firm

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

indicators.note: return means the tax word is read backwards

parts.note: VAT is value added tax

explanation.surface: A book of tax returns accepted by a company that started with nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns VAT to TAV; 'tax return' looks like a form.
explanation.definitionFit: An octavo is a book size, so a volume.

clue.text: Mince pies and preserve inside for gourmets

indicators.note: inside means preserve goes into the rearranged letters
to mince is to chop up, so the letters of pies are rearranged

parts.note: to cure is to preserve meat or fish

explanation.surface: Mince pies with jam inside are for food lovers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mince' rearranges the pies into EPIS, and 'inside' splits that, with the preserving word placed before its final S.
explanation.definitionFit: Epicures are people devoted to fine food and drink.

clue.text: Part of the house decorations that are not wasted

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some of the household trimmings are being reused.
explanation.definitionFit: Used things have served a purpose, not wasted.

clue.text: Christmas decoration? Some let it get out of hand

indicators.note: get out of hand suggests disorder, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some guests let things get rowdy at the festive party.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the plant as a decoration by example.
explanation.definitionFit: Mistletoe is hung up at Christmas for kissing under.
